name: px-swipe-outreach
description: Swipe-to-send customer outreach for retailers: React frontend + Fastify backend.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix retail-outreach-backend install && npm --prefix px-swipe-outreach-frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix retail-outreach-backend run dev" "npm --prefix px-swipe-outreach-frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix retail-outreach-backend run build && npm --prefix px-swipe-outreach-frontend run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix retail-outreach-backend test && npm --prefix px-swipe-outreach-frontend test
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix retail-outreach-backend run typecheck && npm --prefix px-swipe-outreach-frontend run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --prefix retail-outreach-backend run lint && npm --prefix px-swipe-outreach-frontend run lint
